Definition: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
BiblicalUsage: 1) narrow, tight; 2) straits, distress; 3) adversary, foe, enemy, oppressor; 4) hard pebble, flint
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
